verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents first-party streaming: responses are sent back in chunks and displayed incrementally as the model generates them. OpenAI API compatibility suggests the standard streaming wire format, but the evidence never explicitly confirms SSE transport or per-token chunk granularity, and no hands-on report demonstrates streaming. missing for 10: explicit documentation of SSE as the transport, confirmation of token-by-token chunking, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream completions token by token over SSE for responsive user experiences

citations.quote: The Cerebras API supports streaming responses, which send messages back in chunks and display them incrementally as the model generates them.
Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
